final: WITH d AS (SELECT c.country AS country, cs.wins - COALESCE(LAG(cs.wins) OVER (PARTITION BY cs.constructorId, r.year ORDER BY r.round), 0) AS dw FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId), ca AS (SELECT country, AVG(dw) AS a FROM d GROUP BY country), m1 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM ca), k1 AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.a FROM ca, m1 WHERE ca.a > m1.m), m2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM k1), k2 AS (SELECT k1.a FROM k1, m2 WHERE k1.a > m2.m) SELECT AVG(k2.a) AS mean_avg_wins, AVG(k2.a - (SELECT m FROM m1)) AS mean_excess_over_all, AVG(k2.a - (SELECT m FROM m2)) AS mean_excess_over_group FROM k2
